CommercialPolicy_OperationsDescription_A: Wholesale distributor of commercial kitchen and foodservice equipment, parts and supplies to restaurants, hotels, schools and institutional kitchens in Tennessee, Kentucky and northern Alabama. Imports Italian deck ovens and espresso machines and sells a private-label degreaser made by a contract blender. Through its subsidiary it installs, services and repairs the equipment at customer locations. No manufacturing; final electrical and gas connections are subcontracted to licensed trades.
CommercialPolicy_OperationsDescription_B: Cumberland Hearth Service Co., LLC installs, services and repairs commercial kitchen equipment at customer locations, including preventive maintenance contracts and 24-hour emergency service; it has no sales of its own beyond parts used on service calls.
CommercialPolicy_RemarkText_A: Seasonal warehouse labor (up to 9 workers, October through December) is supplied by Harpeth Staffing Solutions, Inc. under a services contract; these workers are not employees of the applicant and are not included in the employee counts.
